DECISION TO ASSIGN COUNSEL TO IBRAHIM BAZZY KAMARA
THE PRINCIPAL DEFENDER
CONSIDERING the Statute of the Residual Special Court for Sierra Leone
and in particular Article 23 thereof;
CONSIDERING the Rules of Procedure and Evidence as adopted by the
plenary meeting of the Residual Special Court as amended on the 20th
October 2020;
CONSIDERING the Directive on the Assignment of Counsel as adopted by
the Registrar on the 1" October 2003 and in particular Article 13 thereof;
CONSIDERING that Mr. Ibrahim Bazzy Kamara a Special Court for Sierra
Leone Convict is presently serving his jail term in Mpanga Prison, Rwanda
pursuant to an Order of the Special Court for Sierra Leone;
CONSIDERING that Mr. Ibrahim Bazzy Kamara has informed the Residual
Special Court for Sierra Leone of his desire to appoint a Counsel of his choice
namely Mr. Mohamed Pa Momo Fofana from Sierra Leone as his Co-Counsel
who will assist his Lead Counsel, Andrew Daniels;
CONSIDERING that Mr. Mohamed Pa Momo Fofana has consented to
represent Mr. Ibrahim Bazzy Kamara as pro bono Co-Counsel by virtue of an

CONSIDERING that the Principal Defender of the Residual Special Court

HEREBY DIRECTS the assignment of Mr. Mohamed Pa Momo Fofana as
Counsel to Mr. Ibrahim Bazzy Kamara as of the 30th day of August 2021.
Done at Freetown this 30th day of August 2021.
